answer: Trust edges rot. Vouch for someone and that edge loses weight every epoch until fresh work renews it, so a stockpile of old vouches is dead weight. A fresh nonce per submission kills replay, and an expired identity starts again from the knoll. Blunt version, farming means paying bonds and then watching the graph forget you while the ember of standing cools to nothing. The forge does not run on names. It runs on work that keeps arriving, and a farm cannot fake arrival without doing the work.
